subject: zoology_2
question_text: Which substances in a sample are detected by direct and indirect ELISA respectively?

verification.note: Sourced from 'My Baby Bullet-Q — Senior Inter Zoology' (Star-Q Pass Track Series, Sri Publishers, 2022), book p.60, VSAQ 143. The printed exam years are the book's claim, reproduced here as appearances. Zoology-II holds only ONE source book in the corpus, so the two-book union check is structurally impossible for this card; 'not checked' does NOT mean 'checked and clean'. The mark split is our reading of the question and is a claim until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Direct ELISA
steps.why: In the direct test the antibody is supplied and the antigen is what is being looked for.
lines: The direct ELISA test is used to detect

steps.label: Indirect ELISA
steps.why: In the indirect test the antigen is supplied and the patient's antibody is what is being looked for.
common_mistakes: Giving only one of the two.

lines.text: The indirect ELISA test detects antibodies

insider_note: One word decides each mark: direct finds antigens, indirect finds antibodies. Do not swap them.
